chapter: Central Avenue clubs, Nordskog, Sheffield and Music Town
title: The Lincoln Theater ad and Popkin Productions
summary: Willard asks about an ad for the all-colored film Four Shall Die and the Popkin company.

story.theme_name: Jazz musicians in the movies and film scoring
story.community_name: Jazz musicians on film and studio scoring

blocks.x: Hmmm. I hadn't ever hear of that paper.
Well, he only ran it two, three years around here, I think.

And there's an ad here for the Lincoln Theater with a picture, "Four Shall Die"--Niel Webster, Mantan Moreland and Dorothy Dandridge. "A Million Dollar Production. All Colored Cast. Mary...Harry M. Popkin Presents..." Was that a...a...
They're still out in Hollywood. They still producin' pictures...Popkin and them...Popkin's Productions or somethin'.
Did they produce only colored pictures, or...

Well, that was a...the starting. That was the starting. They uh...first they ran the Burbank Theater at Sixth and Main for awhile and then they made the Negro picture, and I think Herb Jeffries was in one of their pictures, if I'm not mistaken. I don't know way back there but anyway, they still Popkins Productions...is in the telephone book.
